questions.subject: ALGEBRA_I
questions.learningObjective: simplify a square root by factoring out a perfect square
questions.stem: Which expression equals the square root of 50?

options.misconception: forgot to take the square root of the perfect square factor
leaves the root symbol on the perfect square
multiplies instead of factoring

questions.explanation: Write 50 as 25 times 2, then the square root of 25 is 5, leaving 5 times the square root of 2. Option B stops halfway, leaving the square root unapplied to the perfect square, which is the most common error here.
questions.hint: Factor out the largest perfect square.
